question: What claim about the source of knowledge is being made when it is said that the determination of the Kaula was known only by a particular grace?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
By that lord's grace, something has become known.
The speaker claims to know the determination of the Kaula.
inference: The determination of the Kaula is known to the speaker solely through the grace of the lord of the Kaulas.
uncertainties: The full content of the Kaula determination is not stated here.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula.
